catalysts.headline: Phase 3 REGAL trial of galinpepimut-S (GPS) in AML reached its pre-specified 80th death event, triggering database lock, unblinding and final statistical analysis of the overall-survival primary endpoint; topline results expected later in Q4 2026
catalysts.impact: Shares fell ~18% per one source (TIKR, updated 2026-10-28); a separate source (Insider Monkey) reports a ~13% decline tied to the same news — not reconciled

catalysts.headline: Securities law firm launches investigation into SELLAS Life Sciences over allegedly delayed disclosure of Phase 3 GPS (Galinpepimut-S) trial results after 80th patient death event
Stock dropped approx. 13% to $13.21 following news interpreted as delayed disclosure around the Phase 3 REGAL/GPS trial's 80th-event threshold
catalysts.source: Secondary trading-news aggregator; not independently verified against a company 8-K in this sandbox

catalysts.headline: Licensing partner 3D Medicines reports the Phase 3 REGAL (galinpepimut-S) trial event count at 78 of the 80 pre-specified events as of this settlement date; final analysis is triggered once the 80th event occurs
catalysts.note: Secondary/aggregator sourced (German-language coverage); not independently confirmed against a primary release. Relevant context for the Aug/Sept 2026 disclosure-timing controversy already on file, but does not itself confirm whether the 80th event had occurred by the time of those events.

catalysts.headline: SELLAS reports Q2 2026 financial results: net loss $9.6M ($0.05/share) vs $6.6M ($0.07/share) in Q2 2025; cash $138.3M as of 2026-06-30; Phase 2 SLS009 (1L AML) fully enrolled at 28 patients with topline data expected Q4 2026; Phase 3 REGAL (GPS, AML) final analysis to occur after the 80th prespecified event

notes: PM 2026-11-04: primary update is the 80th-event trigger for Phase 3 REGAL (company IR release). Topline OS results still pending, expected Q4 2026. Next-earnings estimates also diverge further this session (Earnings Whispers Nov 10, other aggregators Nov 11, vs on-file StreetInsider Nov 18) — none company-confirmed; not written into fundamentals.nextEarnings since no single source is more authoritative than what's on file. Market cap/short interest not re-verified this pass (egress-blocked/stale sources); carried over.
